structures.name: 12U Deep-Space CubeSat Bus
structures.description: Standardized aluminum anodized 12U CubeSat chassis with integrated solar cell mounts, internal card cages, and deployer tabs.

structures.name: ESPA-Class SmallSat Modular Bus
structures.description: EELV Secondary Payload Adapter (ESPA) standard satellite platform with carbon-composite panels and multi-payload mounting decks.

structures.name: Heavy Flagship Observatory Platform
structures.description: Rigid beryllium-aluminum truss structure engineered for high thermal stability, heavy instruments, and multi-year deep space voyages.

powerGeneration.name: Body-Mounted Triple-Junction PV
powerGeneration.description: High-efficiency GaInP/GaAs cells bonded directly to outer chassis panels. No deployment mechanism or moving parts.

powerGeneration.name: Deployable Dual-Wing Solar Panels
powerGeneration.description: Spring-hinged deployable wings with silicon solar cell substrates. Fixed orientation relative to spacecraft frame.

powerGeneration.name: Articulated Sun-Tracking Solar Arrays
powerGeneration.description: Motorized dual-axis solar array drive assembly (SADA) that continuously tracks maximum solar incidence angle.

powerGeneration.name: Next-Gen Radioisotope Generator (RTG)
powerGeneration.description: Continuous Pu-238 decay thermoelectric generator. Immune to orbital eclipses and solar distance, but heavy and costly.

powerGeneration.name: Clipper Outer-Solar Mega Arrays
powerGeneration.description: Immense Jupiter-grade solar blankets (3,600W at 1 AU) engineered to harvest faint 3.7% sunlight at Europa (~133W) and Mars/Psyche.

powerGeneration.name: Quad-MMRTG Nuclear Cluster (4x Pu-238)
powerGeneration.description: Four Plutonium-238 isotope generators delivering 650W continuously anywhere from Mercury to Saturn—even powering SAR radar through 9.5 AU Titan clouds.

energyStorage.name: Space-Grade Li-ion Pack (150 Wh)
energyStorage.description: Compact battery pack with integrated cell-balancing circuitry and thermal heater blankets.

energyStorage.name: Modular High-Reliability Li-ion (600 Wh)
energyStorage.description: Dual-string battery assembly with redundant charge controllers for medium SmallSat mission profiles.

energyStorage.name: Heavy-Duty Deep-Cycle Battery (1800 Wh)
energyStorage.description: High-capacity battery matrix capable of sustaining high-power radars or telescopes through 45-minute planetary eclipses.

adcs.name: Magnetic Torquer Coils + Sun Sensor
adcs.description: Interacts with Earth's geomagnetic field to dump momentum and steer. Low cost and robust, but ineffective beyond LEO.

adcs.name: 3-Axis Reaction Wheels + Horizon Sensor
adcs.description: Flywheel momentum exchange system providing smooth, three-axis orientation for imaging satellites.

adcs.name: Dual Star Trackers + Micro-Reaction Wheels
adcs.description: Sub-arcsecond celestial pointing system matching star patterns against deep-sky catalogs. Crucial for astronomy and laser comms.

communications.name: S-Band Omni Patch Antenna
communications.description: Near-omnidirectional coverage for robust command uplink and housekeeping telemetry. Low throughput.

communications.name: X-Band Medium-Gain Horn & Transmitter
communications.description: Standard NASA Near Space Network (NSN) link for returning medium science data volumes during ground station passes.

communications.name: Ka-Band Steerable High-Gain Parabolic Dish
communications.description: Gimballed 0.8m parabolic reflector capable of high-throughput science data dumps to NASA DSN / Ground Network.

communications.name: Deep Space Optical Laser Transceiver (OCTL)
communications.description: Infrared laser downlink delivering gigabit bandwidth. Demands ultra-precise ADCS pointing to hit optical ground stations.

obc.name: Radiation-Tolerant Dual ARM Flight Computer
obc.description: Proven flight heritage computer with error-correcting RAM and hardware watchdog.

obc.name: Radiation-Hardened Quad-Core + FPGA System
obc.description: Heavy rad-hard processor capable of surviving Van Allen radiation belts and deep space cosmic rays.

obc.name: Neuromorphic Edge AI Payload Coprocessor
obc.description: Onboard machine learning processor that filters cloudy Earth images or flags exoplanet transit anomalies in real time, saving 60% downlink bandwidth.

thermal.name: Passive Multi-Layer Insulation (MLI) & Radiators
thermal.description: Aluminized Mylar thermal blankets and optical solar reflectors for passive temperature regulation.

thermal.name: Active Thermal Louvers + Heaters
thermal.description: Thermostatically controlled bimetallic louvers and strip heaters ensuring narrow thermal ranges for cryogenic or optical instruments.
